content:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: PagerDuty alert fired 1776543210 - Severity: P1

pagerduty-bot: Incident 908172 - Trigger: inference-prod-frontend high CPU - Service: infra-sre - Escalation policy: infra-sre-rot

Ops Oncall: ack - I'm looking

Ops Oncall: wait this service shouldn't be infra-sre, it should be platform-serving. paging wrong group

Ravi K: I just checked the PD UI — the alert source is 'inference-prod-frontend' but somehow matched the routing rule 'legacy-inference-mapping' and routed to infra-sre

Sara L: that's the old mapping we were supposed to remove during the migration cutover last quarter

Jordan P: can someone manually reroute? customer-facing inference requests are getting 5xxs and timeouts

Maya (CTO): @Ops Oncall what's the blast radius? are any paying customers affected?

Ops Oncall: quick sample: 3 paying customers showing 500s, overall traffic at ~80% of normal and elevated tail latency. UI sessions timing out in EU region.

Ravi K: reassigning incident in PD to 'platform-serving' and adding platform on-call

[code]
# PD CLI commands run by Ravi
pd incidents add-note 908172 "Reassigning to platform-serving; legacy routing rule triggered"
pd incidents reassign 908172 --service platform-serving
[/code]

pagerduty-bot: Incident 908172 reassigned to platform-serving; new assignees: Sara L, Jordan P

Sara L: ack

Jordan P: on it. doing quick health-checks and looking at nginx upstreams + autoscaling groups

Ops Oncall: temporary mitigation plan: rolling restart 3 backend nodes at a time to drain bad connections

Jordan P: logs show a malformed health-check header from an external probe causing backend to return 502s. That explains 5xxs but not why the alert matched the infra-sre service rule

Ravi K: found the rule: "if alert.source contains 'inference' AND env=prod -> service infra-sre". It was a catch-all added last year during a migration. Disabling it now.

[code]
# disabling legacy routing rule
pd rules disable legacy-inference-mapping --by "Ravi K"
[/code]

Ravi K: disabled. opening a config PR to permanently remove the rule: https://github.com/redwood-infra/pd-routing/pull/456

Maya (CTO): good catch. please add action items to the postmortem and a unit/integration test for routing rules

Ops Oncall: mitigation effective — 5xxs trending down, latency back toward baseline in last 4 minutes

pagerduty-bot: Incident 908172 - Resolved by Jordan P (platform-serving) at 1776543598

Ops Oncall: closing working thread. Follow-ups: 1) remove legacy rule (Ravi) 2) update runbook to include routing rule checks (Sara) 3) synthetic to detect wrong-service pages (Jordan)

Sara L: I'll schedule a runbook walkthrough next week with infra + platform

Jordan P: I'll own the postmortem draft and link the incident timeline

Ravi K: PR link again: https://github.com/redwood-infra/pd-routing/pull/456

incident-bot: Created incident report ticket INC-2026-1155

Ops Oncall: :thumbsup: all clear from my side
